BiblicalUsage: Raphu was an Israelite, the father of Palti, the spy of the tribe of Benjamin. Moses sent twelve men to spy out the land: 'Of the tribe of Benjamin, Palti the son of Raphu.'
TheologicalSignificance: This tells me that Raphu is remembered by his son's errand: his name stands in the list of the spies, and his son saw the land that Israel refused to enter.
